dedup.scope: Targeted neighbours only: the three cards already authored from this same source by other lanes (A-2039-associahedral-magic-formula on thm-MagicFormula, DSH-geom-normal-fan-subdiv on Prop-NormalFan, DSH-geom-transition-map on prop-Transition), the public identity index, the retired-claims record, the current worklist and every card in focused-seeds carrying this source key. Label comparison was done after the corpus label normalisation (colons and spaces to dashes), so a card written as Prop-NormalFan correctly blocks the author label Prop:NormalFan.
compared: DSH-geom-normal-fan-subdiv claims Prop:NormalFan, the description of the normal fan; this lemma is about the folding map L and its interaction with faces, and it does not use or imply that description.

A-2039-associahedral-magic-formula claims thm-MagicFormula, the magic formula for the diagonal, and DSH-geom-transition-map claims prop-Transition; both are different author results of the same paper, neither asserting the four properties of L.
The label of this lemma and of its clauses is free in the corpus after normalisation.
